integrity: The key identity is an exact symbolic first-order expansion of the delayed incidence term, followed by an exact change of variables in the adjoint pairing. The accompanying checker expands the perturbation in a formal polynomial ring and is supplementary to, not a substitute for, the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: The correction concerns only the delay-generated terms in the first variation, adjoint system, and the vector-control stationarity formula for the controlled model as printed. It does not rederive every term in the paper, does not assess the uncontrolled threshold theorems, and does not prove existence or uniqueness for a corrected optimal-control problem. A differently titled earlier public version was not located in the checked searches; the publication date is the earliest verified public date used here.
title: Delay consistency correction for the vector-control optimality system
